evt.claim_boundary: EVT realm for hardware bring-up / validation. Signed with DEV keys only, anti-rollback counter enforced, no production keys or real eSIM/factory credentials present. Digital rootfs-tarball build, not a physical disk image. Kernel/initramfs are reused from the shared bootable_reference artifacts when present locally and are never realm-specific compiled binaries. PRODUCTION_SHIPPING_IMAGE_DEFINITION builds are always unsigned and stamped NOT_RELEASED regardless of the --unsigned flag.

factory.claim_boundary: FACTORY_PROVISIONING_IMAGE runs only on line stations. All identities, MAC ranges, and eSIM credentials issued through this realm in this repo are DEV/TEST dummies (see factory_provisioning module claim boundary). No production key material and no real eSIM/carrier credentials exist here. Digital rootfs-tarball build, not a physical disk image. Kernel/initramfs are reused from the shared bootable_reference artifacts when present locally and are never realm-specific compiled binaries. PRODUCTION_SHIPPING_IMAGE_DEFINITION builds are always unsigned and stamped NOT_RELEASED regardless of the --unsigned flag.

production.claim_boundary: PRODUCTION_SHIPPING_IMAGE_DEFINITION is a complete CONTRACT, not a release. status is always NOT_RELEASED in this repository. trust_roots.key_source is "none" — no production signing key exists, is generated, or is referenced anywhere in this repo. `gunnchctl os-image build production` refuses to run without --unsigned and always emits signing_realm=NOT_RELEASED, claim_boundary=this text, and PRODUCTION_RELEASE_CLAIMED=false. Digital rootfs-tarball build, not a physical disk image. Kernel/initramfs are reused from the shared bootable_reference artifacts when present locally and are never realm-specific compiled binaries. PRODUCTION_SHIPPING_IMAGE_DEFINITION builds are always unsigned and stamped NOT_RELEASED regardless of the --unsigned flag.

recovery.claim_boundary: RECOVERY_IMAGE is the last-resort boot target. Anti-rollback enforced, no dev shell by default, no production keys. Validated only through virtual/simulated boot-failure and rollback tests in this repo, not on physical hardware. Digital rootfs-tarball build, not a physical disk image. Kernel/initramfs are reused from the shared bootable_reference artifacts when present locally and are never realm-specific compiled binaries. PRODUCTION_SHIPPING_IMAGE_DEFINITION builds are always unsigned and stamped NOT_RELEASED regardless of the --unsigned flag.
